name: UofA Development Environment

ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/java:1.//: Pinned to a fully-qualified SDKMAN identifier, not the major version. Asking for "17" resolves through the feature's own listing regex, which builds `17\.?[0-9]*\.?[0-9]*-<distro>` and cannot match Microsoft's current build id `17.0.20+1-ms` -- the `+1` sits exactly where the regex expects the distro suffix. Its availability pre-check uses a looser grep that DOES see 17, so the built-in fallback to Temurin never fires and the build dies with an empty `Version 17 not found. Available versions:`. A fully-qualified id short-circuits that resolution entirely. 17.0.20 is the newest 17 SDKMAN lists; Temurin is what the feature itself falls back to when a distro lacks a version.
